summary: The ChangeReminderNoMaster module allows users to change their forgotten password question and answer without requiring master credentials. The process involves validation of the current password, selection or entry of a new reminder question, and entry of a new answer. The system uses panels for error and warning messages, and redirects users based on their role after successful completion.
purpose: Enable users to securely change their forgotten password question and answer, improving account recovery options without administrator intervention.

fields.name: txtAnswer
fields.purpose: Answer to the selected or custom security question

workflows.name: Change Forgotten Password Question
steps: User either selects a question from ddReminderQuestion or enters a new one in txtReminderQuestion.
Form validated: current password required; question selected or entered; answer minimum 4 characters.
If successful, UserSession.SetMessage confirms change and redirects user.
User redirected to appropriate dashboard (Student/Instructor/StaffAdmin/DC/Supervisor/Tools) based on session.

business_rules: User can either select a predefined question or enter a custom question, but not both at the same time.
Custom question must be at least 10 characters.
Answer must be at least 4 characters.
Blank entry inserted as first item in ddReminderQuestion dropdown.

validations.error: Please enter forgotten password question at least 10 characters.
Please enter an answer at 4 chars.
Please enter an answer at 4 chars.

conditions: If ddReminderQuestion is visible, select question; otherwise, enter custom question.
Redirect based on querystring user role.
system_behavior: ValidationSummary shows message box for validation errors.
JavaScript is injected conditionally for async postbacks.
Default form button set to cmdChangeQuestion.
Redirect executed on cancel or successful change.
exceptions: Validation failures for current password, question selection/entry, answer entry.
